scope: Read-only source and parent-saved native evidence review; no source edits, builds, product calls or new UI interaction.

findings.verdict: Not reproduced in saved evidence; do not record as confirmed product defect
findings.detail: Invalid-form screenshot has only Command Preview, without Valid; AX likewise omits Valid and Run is disabled with parser error. Prior console SUCCESS belongs to the earlier dry run.
findings.cause: Both badge and Run use the same parser-backed isCommandValid. No generic required-fields bypass exists for print.
findings.minimal_regression: Native valid -> raw+window invalid -> repaired valid sequence; compare badge presence, Run enabled state, displayed preview and exact parser explanation. Existing model preflight test alone does not prove rendered UI.

findings.verdict: Confirmed unnamed checkbox nodes in saved AX; root cause not established by source inspection
findings.detail: Seven send-option checkboxes appear only as checkbox 0/1. Visual labels are present. Single Verbose checkbox in list-printers is named, so this is not proof that all Workshop checkbox labels fail.
findings.cause: The custom HStack Toggle already has accessibilityLabel(param.displayName); no missing-modifier claim is supported. Investigate SwiftUI/AppKit accessibility representation of the composed checkbox row.
findings.minimal_fix_scope: Print-scoped reusable checkbox control with a single native semantic Toggle label, help as accessibilityHint, stable accessibilityIdentifier and explicit checkbox accessibility element; preserve bindings, visual help and structured argv. Verify the real AX result rather than adding a duplicate existing label modifier.
findings.minimal_regression: In send and SCP forms enumerate every visible checkbox by semantic name, toggle by name/keyboard, verify value changes and only corresponding argv flag changes. Include valid/invalid transitions, scrolling and beginner/advanced modes; compare list-printers Verbose as named control.

findings.verdict: Confirmed source defect, native reproduction; no new CLI execution in this review
findings.detail: list-printers --format json promises JSON, but empty list returns before format switch. CLI stdout is empty, explanatory text goes to stderr; Workshop merges both streams and displays plain explanation. Populated list already emits JSON array. This is an output-contract bug, not a DICOM PS3.x wire violation.
findings.minimal_fix_scope: Restrict empty-list guidance/return to text mode (printers.isEmpty && format == .text), letting JSON mode serialize the empty array using existing function. No schema change; missing registry remains read-only.
findings.minimal_regression: For absent registry, existing [] registry, and registry emptied by remove-printer: JSON stdout decodes as exactly [], diagnostics are empty, exit success, no unexpected file mutation. Preserve text guidance and populated array. Test shared command + Workshop adapter, then real CLI capture stdout/stderr and native empty-list action.
